properties.name: TRIAL 2026-10-25: a lawyer's case work on a public record (Palin v. New York Times, S.D.N.Y. 17-cv-4853, plaintiff's side before trial) held as a line of reasoning on flo2.io; reflow2 found the contested elements, but witnesses, timelines, second-hand evidence and reading court PDFs are missing
properties.source: Trial agent report, 2026-10-25; design dbf39096640c196e on flo2.io (case-map.md, reflow2-friction-2026-10-25.md)
properties.statement:
An agent-played trial ran on flo2.io (design dbf39096640c196e, reflow2 0.91.0), on the public record via the archive.org RECAP mirror. It recorded 58 evidence records (25 exhibits and 33 testimony excerpts, 31 of them known only through a party's filing), 10 claims, 9 objections, 8 replies, 26 reasoning steps, and 18 questions for two witnesses, saved as case-map.md in the design.

WHAT REFLOW2 FOUND: every element except publication reads contested, and nothing refuted, which is the right picture before trial. All three routes to actual malice are contested together. A reply resting on a witness in a recorded conflict reads unknown. One objection has no supporting evidence. Six evidence records support no claim (unused discovery).

WHAT THE AGENT HAD TO FIND ITSELF: a route resting on one witness's concession; a route resting on one quoted passage; damages resting on one party's word; the other side's strongest contemporaneous document; a witness quoted two ways by the two parties.

LACKS, most important first:
(1) A chat cannot read court PDFs: web fetch returned "compressed PDF binary" and CourtListener returned 403. The agent broke the brief's "no local files" rule to read the saved PDFs as images.
(2) No witness or timeline record. One reported_at cannot hold the event, testimony and filing dates, and speaker and page:line live only in free text.
(3) Credibility and reliability grades weigh nothing, and "rests on one witness" is not computed.
(4) No marker for second-hand evidence: an exhibit known only through a brief reads exactly like the exhibit.
(5) add_artifact needs a sha256 a chat cannot compute.
(6) Citations are free text.
(7) Large documents had to be read 20 pages at a time.
(8) The whole-design read-back trims prose (78 fields cut).

Concrete tool frictions, filed in the design as reflow2-friction-2026-10-25.md:
- the design-an-argument skill's advice to take a legal standard as an assumption raises a false "assumption never discharged" (0.5, twice);
- flo2's read-back hides the unused-evidence finding;
- add_change_event lists baseline_established and then refuses it;
- add_change_event's `affected` does not state its item shape;
- in a role-played session, a status set to accepted is signed in the account owner's name.

ON CONFIDENTIALITY: the analysis (warrants, objections, questions) is written from the documents' text, so keeping documents out of the chat removes most of the value. That points to a flo2 a firm runs itself, or a contract, rather than redaction. See integrated-flo dec:idea-a-person-keeps-confidential-material-in-a-design.

Untriaged; awaits Anthony.
